***

# **WHAT IS THIS?**

This is a mod pack originally designed for the Fabric mod loader in Minecraft: Java Edition version 1.21.1. I aim to create a mod pack that achieves the best possible look and feel for Minecraft: Legacy Edition without significantly altering Minecraft itself or impacting game performance. Furthermore, I want to evoke the nostalgia of this version of the game, which, in my honest opinion, is the best I've ever seen and played.
